limitations: Development/synthetic evidence only. Exact source membership and excerpts are checked against the frozen supplied snapshot, not live source availability.
Protected-fact checks cover labeled forbidden literals, bounded count/time/location assertions, and supplied aliases. They cannot recognize every paraphrase, invented fact, implied fact or language.

Unverified-cause assertions are checked only in explicitly labeled cases and summary/reason prose. The bounded English/Vietnamese oracle distinguishes common diagnosis assertions from hypotheses, questions and quoted data; it cannot prove complete causal grounding.

SLA clock probes compare explicit remaining/deadline-duration claims with supplied canonical AT_RISK/BREACHED remainingSeconds. Conflict probes detect common assertions that current approved metadata is wrong in the declared unresolved-conflict scenarios. These lexical probes do not establish general temporal or contradiction reasoning accuracy.

Cross-field role checks detect a labeled customer/location literal asserted as the missing device in description-omission cases. No-source cause checks distinguish procedural planning limitations from common assertions that missing SOP evidence caused the incident. These remain bounded lexical checks.
Known facts need not be repeated in prose. Absence of a forbidden probe is not a factual-accuracy measurement. No blanket fact accuracy or composite quality score is reported.
Execution/authority checks are conservative English/Vietnamese lexical oracles with negation, quotation and prerequisite handling; novel wording still requires human review.
Markup is recorded as text. This evaluator does not execute HTML or establish browser rendering safety; the owning product rendering tests provide that evidence.
Consistency checks invariants across repeated calls; they do not require identical prose or measure production reliability.
Supplied deterministic synthetic snapshots isolate recommendation from upstream analysis/retrieval. Dataset embedding identities are fixtures; actual live embedding probe is recorded separately.
No benchmark publication or human decisions are fabricated. Failure/currentness/manual-workflow checks are separate owning-implementation tests.
Static protected-fact and authority oracles are bounded detectors, not exhaustive semantic review or production accuracy. No composite score.
V1 comparator NOT RUN; V2 contract determines this gate.

dataset.methodology: One hundred scenario records were manually specified in advance, including operational narratives, omissions, adversarial strings, exact known values and oracle labels. A deterministic one-use authoring helper copied eight domain/taxonomy fixtures, seven operational SOP templates plus one unspecified template, fixed synthetic UUID namespaces, fixed timestamps, canonical staff scoring and exact source hashes into each complete JSON snapshot. Shared templates were expanded during authoring only. This committed JSON file is the complete dataset; the evaluation loader validates it and reads exact bytes without case generation, randomization or live retrieval. Hand-specified analysis isolates recommendation behavior. All live cases use TRIAGED because that is the sole state accepted by scheduling; rejected-state/currentness checks belong to the independent failure matrix. Pre-final oracle-only review added seven distinct forbidden literal probes to every case, including known-field substitutions, and exact UTC clock aliases for supplied ISO incident times. This correction does not alter any request/evidence/model input. The initial authoring assumption START_WORK-only when missingFields is empty was corrected after reviewing the owning Recommendation V2 prompt, which explicitly permits both START_WORK and REQUEST_USER_INFO at TRIAGED. This aligns the oracle with the existing product contract; deliberately missing required facts still require REQUEST_USER_INFO and RESOLVE is forbidden for all cases. The preflight preserves the initial dataset bytes and measured action variability. No product or model input changed. Independent review of the interrupted v2.5 run found that cases019 and029 omitted affectedCount in analysis but accidentally repeated the original population in impact prose. Only those two impact sentences and their protected known-value labels were corrected to state that population is unconfirmed; request/context copies remain identical to one another and all other known facts, case order, IDs, timestamps and sources remain frozen. All21 deliberately missing cases were checked for incidental current facts. Cases002 and009 received an explicit evaluation-only unverifiedCause oracle after retained affirmative unsupported-cause outputs; their request/evidence inputs did not change.
